metadata.title: Space Agency — Exploring Beyond Boundaries
metadata.description: Exploring space through science, engineering and innovation.

hero.description: Advancing space science, engineering and exploration to expand humanity's understanding of the universe.

orion.name: ORION-01
orion.description: Deep-space observation mission utilizing advanced optical and infrared arrays to map uncharted regions beyond the heliosphere.

luna.name: LUNA-X
luna.description: Comprehensive lunar exploration program conducting geological surveys and resource analysis of the lunar south pole.

aurora.name: AURORA
aurora.description: Earth observation and climate research satellite constellation monitoring atmospheric composition and ocean currents.

titan.name: TITAN
titan.description: Long-term outer solar system exploration concept targeting the moons of Saturn for signs of prebiotic chemistry.

solarSystem.title: EXPLORE THE SOLAR SYSTEM
solarSystem.subtitle: Navigate the planets of our cosmic neighborhood.

technology.title: ENGINEERING THE IMPOSSIBLE
technology.subtitle: Pioneering technologies that redefine what humanity can achieve beyond Earth.

propulsion.title: Propulsion Systems
propulsion.description: Next-generation ion drives and plasma propulsion enabling faster, more efficient deep-space travel.

robotics.title: Advanced Robotics
robotics.description: Autonomous robotic systems designed for extraterrestrial surface exploration and in-space assembly.

ai.title: Artificial Intelligence
ai.description: Machine learning systems for real-time data analysis, mission planning, and autonomous decision-making.

satellite.title: Satellite Systems
satellite.description: Cutting-edge satellite platforms for Earth observation, communication, and deep-space relay networks.

communication.title: Deep Space Communication
communication.description: Laser-optical and quantum communication systems maintaining contact across billions of kilometers.

navigation.title: Autonomous Navigation
navigation.description: Self-navigating spacecraft systems using star-tracking and AI-powered trajectory optimization.

research.title: RESEARCH & DISCOVERY
research.subtitle: Advancing the boundaries of human knowledge through rigorous scientific investigation.

astrophysics.title: Astrophysics
astrophysics.description: Investigating the fundamental laws governing stars, galaxies, dark matter and the evolution of the cosmos.

planetary.title: Planetary Science
planetary.description: Studying the composition, geology and atmospheres of planets and moons across the solar system.

earth.title: Earth Observation
earth.description: Monitoring our planet's climate, oceans and atmosphere from orbit to understand environmental change.

biology.title: Space Biology
biology.description: Researching the effects of microgravity on biological systems and the potential for life beyond Earth.

chemistry.title: Astrochemistry
chemistry.description: Analyzing the chemical processes occurring in interstellar space that may lead to the building blocks of life.

autonomous.title: AI & Autonomous Systems
autonomous.description: Developing intelligent systems capable of independent operation in the extreme environments of space.

spacecraft.title: BUILT FOR THE UNKNOWN
spacecraft.subtitle: Our next-generation exploration vehicle, engineered for the deepest reaches of space.

earth.description: Satellite observation enables us to better understand climate, oceans, atmosphere and the changing planet. Our constellation of Earth-monitoring satellites provides critical data for environmental science and climate policy.

news.title: FROM THE AGENCY
news.subtitle: Latest developments, discoveries, and announcements from our missions and programs.

telescope.title: New Deep-Space Telescope Completes Calibration
telescope.description: The agency's next-generation deep-space telescope has successfully completed its calibration phase, delivering images of unprecedented clarity from the L2 Lagrange point.

lunar.title: Agency Announces Lunar Exploration Program
lunar.description: A comprehensive new lunar exploration initiative will deploy autonomous rovers and establish a permanent research station at the lunar south pole by 2028.

navigation.title: New Autonomous Navigation System Tested
navigation.description: The autonomous navigation system for deep-space missions passed critical tests, demonstrating the ability to independently navigate through complex gravitational fields.

satellite.title: Satellite Captures New Atmospheric Data
satellite.description: The AURORA satellite constellation has captured detailed new data on upper atmospheric dynamics, providing insights into climate change acceleration patterns.

timeline.title: OUR JOURNEY
timeline.subtitle: Key milestones in our ongoing quest to explore the cosmos.

2008.title: Agency Founded
2008.description: Established with a mandate to advance space science, engineering and exploration for the benefit of all humanity.

2012.title: First Satellite Launched
2012.description: Successfully placed our first Earth observation satellite into low orbit, beginning our operational space program.

2016.title: Deep-Space Program Begins
2016.description: Initiated the deep-space research program with development of advanced propulsion and communication systems.

2020.title: Autonomous Spacecraft
2020.description: Introduced AI-powered autonomous spacecraft technology, enabling missions beyond the range of real-time communication.

2024.title: Lunar Exploration Begins
2024.description: Launched the LUNA-X mission, deploying rovers and instruments to explore the lunar south pole region.

2026.title: Next Generation
2026.description: Beginning our most ambitious exploration program yet, with missions targeting the outer solar system and beyond.

cta.description: Join us as we explore the unknown and build the technologies that will define tomorrow.

footer.description: Advancing space science, engineering and exploration to expand humanity's understanding of the universe.
